name: goat-product-void
description: Product Void · Хоосон дэвсгэр: shows each product photo alone in pure black or white space, Apple-style: a floating cut-out when its background is removed, a clean rounded card when it isn't, with a soft glow, a passing sheen, a floor reflection, a slow push-in, one clean Mongolian headline and a price line in the product's own colour, built on HyperFrames. Renders a 1080x1920 MP4 for Reels/TikTok.
